quote: CAMCE announced that the company has signed a business contract for the supporting road project of Punta Huete International Airport with the Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure of Nicaragua. The contract amount is USD 71.9647 million, equivalent to approximately RMB 513 million, accounting for 4.20% of the company's total revenue in 2024. The project involves the construction of supporting roads for the airport, including design, procurement, and construction, with a construction period of 24 months from the date of the notice to proceed.
note: Opened Longbridge/Zhitong reprint of CAMCE (002051.SZ) contract announcement 24 Aug 2025.
